extensionName.message: YT Playlist Tools — Reverse, Shuffle & Reorder

extensionDescription.message: Reverse, shuffle, reorder, save, and export YouTube playlists. Includes watched badges, auto-skip, loop mode and compact UI.

cmdReverse.message: Toggle Reverse on the current playlist

cmdShuffle.message: Toggle Shuffle on the current playlist

cmdAddToList.message: Add the current video to a local playlist

cmdLoadAll.message: Load every video of the current playlist
